name: Honduras
description: Honduras from the Maya city of Copán to Spanish rule, independence, the banana republic, the coup of 2009 and today.

checkpoints.name: Copán
checkpoints.note: The Maya kings of Copán ruled from 426 until the city faded around 900.

checkpoints.name: Spanish rule
checkpoints.note: Columbus reached the coast in 1502. Lempira fought the conquest, and silver mines grew up round Tegucigalpa.

checkpoints.name: Republic
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1821. Banana companies ruled the north. Hurricane Mitch struck in 1998, and a coup removed the president in 2009.
